run_label: Archive Expansion — outsider art, feminist originals, vintage magazines, historical erotica and ephemeral radio
purpose: Substantive current upload batch to existing topical directories; create only Outsider-Art/ where absent. Preserve source attributions, rights and byte hashes; no dated content dump.

items.name: Feminism/Charlotte-Perkins-Gilman-Women-and-Economics-1898-First-Printing.pdf
items.creator: Charlotte Perkins Gilman
items.description: Complete 358-page first printing of Women and Economics; primary-source feminist economic critique.

items.name: Outsider-Art/Adolf-Wolfli-Hotel-Berner-Hof-1905.jpg
items.creator: Adolf Wölfli (1905 drawing); JoJan (2010 photograph)
items.license: Adolf Wölfli original drawing public domain; JoJan photograph CC BY 3.0, attribution required
items.description: Hotel Berner-Hof pencil work (1905), canonical outsider / Art Brut visionary drawing held at LaM Lille Métropole museum.

items.name: Erotic-Art/La-Vie-Parisienne-1916-12-23-Complete-Issue.pdf
items.creator: La Vie Parisienne (French illustrated magazine; scanned by Bibliothèque nationale de France via Gallica)
items.license: Public domain US and France (Commons PD tags; source Gallica BnF)
items.description: Complete 23-page issue (No. 54) of the risqué French illustrated satirical and lifestyle periodical, an unusually vivid source for belle-époque/post-belle-époque erotic print culture.

items.name: Computer Documents/InfoWorld-Volume-1-Issue-11-July-1979.pdf
items.creator: Jim C. Warren Jr., InfoWorld
items.license: Public domain in the US per Wikimedia Commons: 1978-1989 US publication without copyright notice and no registration in 5 years
items.description: Complete 24-page issue 1.11 of early microcomputing trade magazine InfoWorld, a snapshot of the 1979 software industry.

items.name: Computer Documents/KIM-1-MOS-Technology-BYTE-Ad-1976.jpg
items.creator: MOS Technology; scan Michael Holley
items.license: Public domain US per Commons: U.S. advertisement published without copyright notice
items.description: Original MOS Technology KIM-1 microcomputer debut advertisement in BYTE magazine, May 1976; companion artifact for vintage computer experience.

items.name: Recordings/Lincolnshire-Poacher-Numbers-Station-E3-2007.ogg
items.creator: Oona Räisänen (recordist)
items.description: 26-second surviving noisy shortwave recording of Lincolnshire Poacher numbers station ENIGMA E3; ephemeral Cold War-era-style coded radio practice captured in 2007.
